measurement_basis: focused append-only correction tests, static checks, and a prior live projection contract diagnostic

related_work.campaign_objective: Improve MNCS's ability to observe, interpret, and improve how the environment serves agents working within MNCS.
related_work.work_intent_goal: Improve MNCS's ability to observe, interpret, and improve how the environment serves agents working within MNCS.

request.focused_test_command: python -m pytest tests/test_capability_intelligence.py -q -k 'observation_contract_correction or observation_correction_cannot_rewrite_valid_pressure_recommendation or append_only_pressure_role_correction'

outcome.verified_behavior: The append-only observation-correction contract can restore one bounded actionable recommendation on an integrity-verified record, revalidate the complete pressure hypothesis contract, preserve the original record pointer, and expose the applied replacement in compact projection output.
outcome.preservation_boundary: The correction changes only the projection's effective value. It does not rewrite the target blob or permit rewriting a valid target.
outcome.interpretation_limit: The focused tests establish correction behavior. They do not show that an agent used the repaired projection or that the represented pressure has been eliminated.

pressure_hypothesis.title: The observation correction contract cannot restore a missing pressure recommendation
pressure_hypothesis.basis: A live Environmental Capability projection excluded an integrity-addressable readback record with missing-pressure-hypothesis-actionable-recommendation. The correction allowlist had no exact path for that field, so its contract-invalid record had no append-only recovery route.
pressure_hypothesis.actionable_recommendation: Allow exact-field append-only correction of a missing actionable recommendation only after target integrity verification and full contract revalidation.
not_measured: whether any agent depended on the excluded readback before correction support existed
whether other missing pressure fields require distinct safe correction paths
whether the repaired record changes future agent decisions
production frequency of missing recommendation diagnostics
agent-visible reduction in repeated reconstruction or context loss
whether the affected coordination pressure recurs after correction
